feature_hierarchy.classical_stochastic_control: learned-MIA features plus dispersion from ten class-multinomial draws matched to 128 shots
feature_hierarchy.clean_z_diagnostic: exact probability-vector statistics plus exact Pauli-Z marginals; privileged diagnostic only
feature_hierarchy.fixed_joint: fixed_marginal plus the aggregate layout-A 64-outcome bitstring distribution and pairwise Z covariance
feature_hierarchy.fixed_marginal: learned-MIA features plus layout-A Pauli-Z mean and dispersion
feature_hierarchy.learned_mia: layout-A mean prediction vector plus loss, entropy, confidence, margin, and correctness
feature_hierarchy.loss_mia: true-class probability from ten layout-A queries
feature_hierarchy.paired_joint_probe: paired_marginal_probe plus per-layout 64-outcome distributions and pairwise Z covariance differences
feature_hierarchy.paired_marginal_probe: paired_probability_probe plus per-layout Pauli-Z marginals and differences
feature_hierarchy.paired_probability_probe: five layout-A and five layout-B final-probability responses, their dispersion, and channel differences
